description: Large liane; branchlets at first tomentellous, later glabrescent. Leaves: petioles with tomentellous swellings at both ends, otherwise subglabrous, 2–10 cm; lamina elliptic-oblong or elliptic, base cuneate to broadly rounded, apex acuminate, (11–)19–32 by (4–)7–14 cm; 1–2 pairs of sub-basal nerves apart from 3–4 pairs of lateral nerves, nerves and reticulation raised on both surfaces, glabrous, upper surface often shining, thinly coriaceous. Inflorescences axillary and on older, leafless stems. Male flowers in axillary or ramiflorous fascicles; pedicels 4–6 mm, tomentellous; outer sepals 3+3, 1.5 mm long, tomentellous; inner calyx creamy-white to yellow, 10 mm long, externally tomentelluus; petals 3, fleshy, oblate, scarcely 1 mm long; lateral margins inflexed; synandrium 5 mm long, consisting of 24 stamens, in 6 vertical rows of 4. Female flowers solitary; outer sepals similar to male; inner calyx 6 mm long; petals 6, ± obovate, 1 mm long, glabrous; staminodes subulate, 2 mm; carpels 4–6, elongate-ovoid, 2.5 mm long, tomentellous, attenuated into a 1 mm long, subulate, glabrous style. Drupes orange, oblong-ellipsoidal to obovoid-ellipsoidal, 2.5–3.8 by 2–2.6 cm, on peduncle, ca 4 mm thick and 10 mm long; endocarp with a marginal raised ridge, 3 by 1.7 cm, smooth, crustaceous.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber; stems subtomentellous to puberulous when young, later glabrescent. Leaves with slender pubemlous petioles, 2–6 cm, not conspicuously thickened at the base or apex; lamina ovate to lanceolate, base rounded, apex attenuately acute, 9–16.5 by 4–8.5 cm, 2 pairs of sub-basal nerves, and 1–2 pairs of distal main lateral nerves, the nerves and fine reticulation raised on both surfaces, glabrous above, puberulous along nerves below, papyraceous. Male inflorescences and flowers unknown. Female flowers solitary, axillary on tomentose pedicels, 6 mm long; outer sepals in 2 whorls of 3, narrowly triangular, externally densely pubescent, the outermost 1.2 mm long, the next inner 2 mm long; inner calyx narrowly urceolate, very shortly 3-lobed, 7 mm long, externally pubescent-pilose; petals 6, rotund, subauriculate at base, 1 mm long, externally sparsely pilose; staminodes (not observed); carpels 6, curved-ellipsoidal, 1.5 mm long, densely pilose with a subulate, glabrous style, 2.5 mm long. Drupes orange, ellipsoidal, 1.5 by 0.8 cm, puberulous, on peduncles 3–7 mm long; endocarp subellipsoidal, slightly curved and flattened with a low dorsal ridge; the smooth surface covered with fine branched grooves.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Albertisia puberula . Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 3, 1991. Pg. 308. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Young stems and petioles, usually drying pale greyish straw-coloured, striate, glabrous. Leaves ovate to broadly ovate, 16–28 by 10–24 cm, base cordate to truncate (or broadly obtuse), apex usually acuminate, palmately 3–5(–7)-nerved, at base and with 4–5 pairs of lateral nerves running, ± parallel with the main, i.e. distal, pair of basal nerves, the lateral nerves linked together with scalariform veins, reticulum clearly visible and slightly raised below; glabrous on both surfaces apart from pockets of hairs, in the axils of the nerves and main veins; thinly coriaceous; petioles glabrous, 6–18(–26) cm, swollen at both ends, geniculate at the base. Inflorescences 16–40 cm, with lateral branches, 2–5 cm, glabrous; bracteoles ca 0.5 mm long. Male flowers with glabrous pedicels, up to 2–3 mm; sepals white, yellow or pale green; outer sepals 2, scarcely 1 mm long; inner sepals 6, broadly elliptic, 2.5–3 by 2 mm, glabrous; apart-from often minutely papillose margin; synandrium 1.5–2 mm long. Female flowers: sepals as in male; staminodes 6, minute, scarcely 0.25 mm; carpels 3(–4), curved-ellipsoidal, 1.5–2 mm; stigma thick, recurved. Infructescences wholly glabrous, lateral branches, up to 15 cm; carpophore (3–)6–16 mm, continuous with pedicels, 8–20 mm. Drupes white to purple, 9–11 mm long, glabrous; endocarp subreniform-globose, surface reticulate-rugulose with a weak dorsal groove; cotyledons ± narrowly elliptic, 5–7 mm long, 2 mm broad.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Anamirta cocculus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 3, 1991. Pg. 337. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Plant glabrous apart from leaf-domatia; stems with yellow wood and exudingyellow sap when cut, bearing prominent cup-like, petiole-scars. Leaves usually ovate, elliptic-ovate or broadly ovate, (10–)12–25 by (5.5–)8–19 cm, base usually rounded, truncate or slightly cordate, apex abruptly acuminate, palmately 5-nerved, at the base and with 1–3 pairs of lateral nerves, usually arising from above halfway along the midrib; both surfaces usually drying matt with a rather obscure reticulum, coriaceous; petioles (4–)7–15(–20) cm, swollen at both ends, geniculate at base. Inflorescences 10–50 cm, lateral branches, 1–5 cm. Male flowers sessile or subsessile subtended by an ovate bracteole, ca 1 mm long, which is strongly thickened at the base; outer sepals, 3–4, less than 1 mm long; inner sepals larger, 3 +3, elliptic, ovate or narrowly obovate, 1.5–2.5 mm long. Syandrium 0.5–1 mm long. Female flowers: main sepals 6, narrowly oblong with the apex becoming reflexed, 2.5–4 mm long; staminodes minute, scale-like; carpels 3, 1.5 mm long; stigma broad, sessile, papillose. Infructescences cauliflorous, usually branched, (5–)7–30(–45) cm, with thickened axis and branches, 3–6 mm diam., the fruits plus carpophores borne on the lateral branches, 1–3 borne together on a club-shaped, unbranched carpophore swollen at the apex, up to 4 cm. Drupes yellow, slightly laterally Compressed, transversely subovoid, 2.2–3 by 2.5–3.3 cm (long axis), 2–2.5 cm thick, drying finely rugulose, glabrous; endocarp woody.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Arcangelisia flava. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 3, 1991. Pg. 339. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stem tomentose when very young, later pubescent to glabrescent, striate, when old with prominent corky longitudinal ridges, up to ca 5 cm diam. Leaves scarcely peltate (outside Thailand petiole inserted, 1–2 mm from basal margin); petioles densely patent-pubescent, 7–12 cm; lamina ovate to broadly ovate, base cordate to truncate, rarely distally 3-lobed and with pointed subhastate basal lobes, apex caudate-acuminate, 9–19 by 7–17 cm, palmately 5(–7)-nerved at base with 2(–3) pairs of lateral nerves, both surfaces pubescent especially around base and along nerves; thinly papyraceous. Inflorescences up to 35 cm long, lateral branches 1–3 cm, patent-pubescent. Male flowers on pubescent pedicels, 1–3 mm; sepals 6–12, outer 3–6 green, ± narrowly elliptic, 2–3.5 mm long, puberulous, inner 3–6, yellow, obovate to broadly elliptic, 3 mm long, glabrous; petals 6, yellowish-green, cuneate-obovate with lateral edges inrolled, apically truncate; synandrium 2 mm long, column thick. Female flowers: sepals as in male; petals narrower; staminodes 1.5 mm long; carpels narrowly subovoid, 1.5 mm long; stigma reflexed, lobed. Drupes dark red, glabrous, drying flattened with a prominent longitudinal dorsal ridge, oblong-ovate in outline; endocarp flattened, scutiform, 17 by 10 mm, pointed at base and apex, marginal wings notched along the edge.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aspidocarya uvifera. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 3, 1991. Pg. 333. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Young parts red-brown hairy. Leaves subcoriaceous, ovate-elliptic to ovate-oblong, 5–9 by 2.5–6 cm; apex retuse; base obtuse or rounded; mature leaves glabrous, except the proximal part of the midrib beneath; margin hyaline and often red hairy; lateral veins 4–5 pairs; petiole 1–1.5 cm long, sparsely hairy. Inflorescences rusty brownish pubescent, with short rachis, up to 12 cm long; peduncle 0.5–5 cm long; pedicels articulate at the middle, basal part densely hairy, more sparsely hairy towards the tip, older glabrous, except below the bracteoles, in flower 1–1.5 cm long, in fruit 2.5–3.5 cm long; bracts ca 1 mm long; bracteoles minute. Sepals ovate-oblong; apex rounded, ca 2 by 1 mm, glabrous. Petals whitish, oblong; apex rounded, 4–5 by 2–3 mm. Stamens: filaments 1.5–2 mm long, as long as the anthers. Ovary glabrous; styles 3–4 mm long; disk-lobes persistent, ca 2 mm long. Mericarps: lateral wings orbicular, pale, translucent; dorsal wing small, broadened towards base. Seeds triangular, 5–6 by 3–4 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aspidopterys concava. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 3, 1991. Pg. 288. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: All parts except flowers yellowish-brown, hirsute. Leaves subcoriaceous, elliptic, ovate to obovate, 7–17 by 4–10 cm; apex acuminate to cuspidate; base subcordate; flower surface glaucous; margin ciliate; lateral veins, 6–9 pairs: petiole 4–10 mm lomg. Inflorescences with branches regularly opposite, umbel-like; pedicels articulate below middle, 3–7 mm long; bracts lanceolate, acute, 4–8 mm long; bracteoles acute, 1–2 mm long. Sepals oblong, apex rounded, base truncate, ca 2 by 1 mm, glabrous. Petals obovate, apex rounded, base truncate, keeled, 3–4 by 2–2.5 mm. Stamens: filaments 1–1.5 mm long; anthers 1.5–2 mm long. Ovary glabrous, globose, 0.5–1 mm in diam.; styles ca 3 mm long. Mericarps: lateral wings oblong, slightly narrowed towards the apex, both ends rounded or truncate, sometimes slightly repanda coriaceous, glabrous, 3.2–6 by 1–2 cm; dorsal wing undeveloped. Seeds linear, ca 7–10 by 2–3 m.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aspidopterys hirsuta. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 3, 1991. Pg. 293. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Young parts mostly white-pubescent; old branches glabrous. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic, ovate, obovate or suborbicular, 6.5–13 by 5–12 cm; apex acuminate to cuspidate or mucronate; base obtuse, rounded or subcordate; upper surface glabrous; flower surface white-pubescent; nerves preminent; lateral veins 4–7(–8) pairs; petiole 1–4 cm long, pubescent, becoming glabrous with longitudinal ridges. Inflorescences up to 28 cm long; peduncle up to 7.5 cm long, pubescent; pedicels glabrous, articulate at middle or above, in fIower 2–18 mm long, in fruit 12–22 mm long; bracts lanceolate, 1–7 mm long; bracteoles acute, ca 1 mm long. Sepals obovate-oblong, apex rounded, base truncate, 1–2 by 1 mm, glabrous. Petals oblong to elliptic-oblong, apex rounded, base truncate, 4–5 by 2–2.5 mm. Stamens: filaments 1.5–2.5 mm long, filiform, broadened and slightly connate at base; anthers l–1.2 mm long. Ovary hirsute, globose, ca 1 mm in diam.; style 2–2.5 mm long. Mericarps: lateral wings ovate, apex emarginate or rounded, long whitish hairy, membranous, 1.8–3.5 by 1.3–2.5 cm; dorsal wing undeveloped; carpophore pyramidal, 1–2 mm high; disk-lobes acute, ca 1 mm high. Seeds linear, ca 10 by 2 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aspidopterys nutans. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 3, 1991. Pg. 291. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Young parts rusty brownish hairy, becoming glabrous. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic, elliptic-ovate or obovate, 7–18 by 4–10 cm; apex acuminate to cuspidate; base subcordate; upper surface glabrous; flower surface brownish pubescent; lateral veins 5–8(–9) pairs; petiole 0–5 mm. Inflorescences pubescent; pedicels slender, articulate below middle, 3–15 mm long, pubescent; bracts lanceolate, 3–10 mm long; bracteoles acute, 1–2 mm long. Sepals ovate to ovate-oblong, apex rounded, base truncate, 2–3 by 1 mm, glabrous. Petals light yellowish, obovate-oblong, apex rounded, base truncate, keeled, 4.5–6 by 3 mm, sometimes ciliate. Stamens: filaments ca 1.8–2.5 mm long; anthers ca 1.5–2 mm long. Ovary glabrous, globose, ca 0.5 mm in diam.; style 2–2.5 mm long. Mericarps: lateral wings oblong, both ends rounded, truncate, or emarginate, coriaceous, glabrous, 2.5–5.2 by 1–1.8 cm; dorsal wing not developed. Seeds linear, 10 by 1.5 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aspidopterys thorelii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 3, 1991. Pg. 295. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Branches pale brownish to dark reddish-brown hairy; older branches glabrescent. Leaves coriaceous, suborbicular, ovate, obovate, lanceolate or elliptic, 6–13 by 5–14 cm; apex obcordate-cuspidate, rounded-cuspidate or acuminate; base rounded to subcordate, cuneate; upper surface glabrous except when young, often glaucous when dry, nerves sulcate; flower surface densely yellowish or brownish hairy, or sometimes glabrous except on midrib, veins prominent; lateral veins, 4–6 pairs; petiole 1–4 cm, hairy. Inflorescences up to 27 cm long; peduncle 1.5–7 cm long, yellowish or brownish hairy, as well as the rachis; pedicels slender, articulate below middle, glabrous except below the bracteoles, 0.5–2 cm long; bracts acute, 2–3 mm long; bracteoles acute, ca 1 mm long. Sepals ovate-oblong, apex rounded, base truncate, ca 3 by 1 mm, glabrous. Petals white to light yellowish, oblong, apex rounded, base truncate, 5–6 by 1–1.5 mm. Stamens: filaments, 2–2.5 mm long; anthers ca 1 mm long. Ovary glabrous, ovoid, ca 1 mm in diam.; styles ca 3 mm long. Mericarps: lateral wings ovate, apex emarginate, pale translucent, 2.5–3.5 by 1.5–3 cm, glabrous; dorsal wing 3–4 mm high; carpophore acute, 4–6 mm long, persistent. Seeds linear, ca 10 by 2 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aspidopterys tomentosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 3, 1991. Pg. 289. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Herb up to 1 m, sometimes more; often richly branched, erect or decumbent at base, glabrous or puberulous particularly in the upper part. Leaves ovate-oblong or lanceolate, acute to obtuse at apex, truncate to rounded at base, 2–4 by 1.5–3 cm; flower surface often whitish with inserted, reddish glands along the margin; upper surface green. Petioles 1–4 cm. Inflorescences lax, many-flowered; ultimate peduncles glandular, terminated by a small cymose group of flowers. Pedicels 0.5–2 mm; bracteoles 1–2 mm long. Perianth campanulate, ca 2 mm long, constricted at the middle, white, pink or red. Stamens 2–3, slightly exserted. Ovary ovoid; style slightly exserted; stigma capitate-discoid. Anthocarp clavate, 2–3 mm long, with 5 longitudinal ribs with scattered, minute, sessile and stipitate glands.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Boerhavia diffusa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 3, 1991. Pg. 372. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Slender herb, up to 80 cm, puberulous particularly towards apex. Leaves thin, ovate-oblong to lanceolate with rounded to truncate base; apex acute, 2–3.5 by 1–2.5 cm; flower surface often whitish and with inserted red glands. Petioles 2–4 cm. Inflorescences an open panicle; ultimate branches with cymes, 2–3 flowers, with peduncle 1.5–2 cm. Pedicels 0.5–5 mm. Perianth white, pink or red, tubular-campanulate, ca 2 mm, constricted about the middle. Stamens 1–2, exserted for 0.5 mm as the stigma. Anthocarp obconical, broadest at the truncate apex, glabrous, with 5 strongly marked ribs, star-shaped in cross-section.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Boerhavia erecta. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 3, 1991. Pg. 372. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Shrub ca 1 m tall; nodes bearded with brownish hairs. Leaves membranous, unequal-sided, elliptic-oblong to oblanceolate, 10–15 by 4–5 cm; apex caudate-acuminate; base cuneate; lateral nerves, 7–9 pairs, anastomosing 5–12 mm from the margin, prominent on flower surface; petiole 2–5 mm long, sulcate. Stipules acicular, ca 3 mm long. Raceme up to 12 cm long; pedicels 3–5 mm long; bracts and bracteoles persistent, ciliate. Sepals imbricate, ovate, obtuse, 1.5–2.5 by 1–1.5 mm. Petals oblong-obtuse, 8–12 by 4–5 mm. Stamens with filaments of inner whorl straight, 2 mm long; those of outer whorl curved, about twice as long; anthers 4 mm long. Ovary ovate, ca 2 mm long; styles 0.8–1 cm long. Mericarps with dorsal crest, reticulate, hairy, 4–5 mm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Brachylophon anastomosans. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 3, 1991. Pg. 297. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Small tree, ca 5 m tall; nodes bearded with copius, shiny brown hairs. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic to elliptic-oblong, 10–20 by 4–7 cm; apex acuminate; base acute; lateral veins, 7–12 pairs, anastomosing 2–3 mm from the margin; petiole 2–3 mm long, sulcate, broader at base. Stipules triangular, ca 2 mm long. Raceme ca 1–2 cm long; pedicels 2–3 cm long; bracts and bracteoles caducous, minute, ciliate. Sepals obtuse with broad base, 2–3 by 1.2 mm. Petals obtuse, more or less narrowed towards the base, 9–10 by 3–6 mm, finely ciliate. Stamens with filaments of outer whorl, 5–7 mm long, slightly longer and broader than the inner ones; anthers 3–5 mm long. Ovary ovate, ca 2–3 mm long; styles ca 1 cm long. Mericarps with dorsal crest, reticulate, glabrous, 1–1.5 cm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Brachylophon curtisii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 3, 1991. Pg. 297. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree, up to 25 m high; bark smooth, greyish; twigs lenticellate; young shoots, leaf rachis and inflorescences axis puberulous to pubescent. Leaves alternate, imparipinnate, 30–80 cm long; stipules very early caducous; leaflets sessile or shortly petiolulate, 4–8 pairs; opposite or subopposite; membranous, lanceolate–oblong to ovate-lanceolate, 8–25 by 2.5–6 cm; glabrous on both surfaces or slightly hairy on midrib; flower surface glaucous; base cuneate to rounded; unequal sided, except on the terminal leaflet; apex acute to acuminate; lateral veins 10–15 pairs. Inflorescence a terminal raceme, up to 40 cm long. Flowers showy, pink, 3.5–4 cm long, 3.5–4 cm diam.; pedicels 2–3 cm long, puberulous. Calyx large, campanulate, teeth shallow, ca 2 cm long; pubescent on both surfaces. Petals all similar, concave; broadly obovate to suborbicular, 1.8–2 by 1.8–2 cm; apex rounded; base cuneate and gradually, narrowing into the claw; claw about half as long as the petal. Stamens 8, filaments stout, terete, 2.5–3 cm long; pubescent, close together in fine group; all declining towards the upper side of the flower and curved downwards. Ovary broadly, ellipsoid to globular, 3–4 mm long; sessile, pubescent; style 3.5–4 cm long. Fruit spindle-shaped, 4 cm long, dehiscent; the valves 1.5–2 cm wide. Seeds ellipsoid, one to two in each valve, ca 20 by 12 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree, 1.5–4 m; branches glabrous, sometimes brown tomentose, soon or tardily glabrescent; thorns straight, 2–3 mm long, or wanting. Leaves elliptic, sometimes ovate, 4.5–9 by 2.5–4.5 cm, papery, sometimes subcoriaceous; base acute or cuneate; apex abruptly acuminate, tip up to 1 cm; nerves 4–5 pairs, arched. Petiole 4–8 mm. Flowers arranged in supra-axillary rows. Pedicels 13–20 mm. Sepals 4–5 by 2–2.5 mm, outside glabrous, inside tomentose, ciliate. Petals oblong, 7 by 2.5–3 mm, densely tomentose on both sides, ciliate. Gynophore 7–22 mm, glabrous, rarely thinly puberulous towards the base. Ovary ovoid or ellipsoidal, 1–1.5 by 1 mm, glabrous. Fruits globose, 1–1.5 cm in diam.; pericarp thin, smooth; stipe 3–4 cm, slender.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub; branches pubescent, soon glabrescent; shoots with cataphylls at base;thorns small or wanting. Leaves oblong, 12.5–31.5 by 3.5–7.5 cm, subcoriaceous, glabrous, pale below; base acute; apex acuminate; nerves 8–9 pairs; midrib deeply grooved. Petiole ca 5 mm. Flowers in terminal racemes, ca 15 cm long, many-flowered, with small subulate bracts, 2 mm long; rachis slender, sparsely pubescent. Pedicels ca 2 cm. Sepals elliptic, 4 by 2.5 mm, margin thin, sparsely pubescent outside. Petals white, oblong or ovate, 5 by 2 mm, truncate, puberulous towards the base. Stamens about twice as long as the gynophore. Gynophore 8–11 cm, glabrous. Ovary ovoid, 2 by 1 mm, acute, glabrous. Fruits red, borne on a thin stipe, globose, ca 7 mm in diam. Seeds 1.

description: Climber; branches slender, pubescent when young, soon glabrescent; thorns minute, straight, 2 mm long. Leaves elliptic or oblong, 3–8.5 by 1.5–3 cm, subcoriaceous, upper surface often olive greenish, below often brownish when dry; base acute or obtuse; apex acuminate, mostly mucronate; nerves 6–7 pairs, inconspicuous on both surfaces; midrib grooved on the upper surface. Petiole 4–5 mm. Flowers in subumbels arranged in terminal or axillary leafy panicle. Pedicels 4–8 mm; bracts subulate, tomentose, caducous. Sepals 3–5 by 3 mm, margin thin, pubescent outside. Petals obovate, 5–6 by 1.5–2 mm; base narrow; margin pale. Stamens numerous. Gynophore 3.5–5 mm, glabrous. Ovary sub-ellipsoidal, 1.5–2 by 0.5–1 mm, glabrous. Fruit ellipsoidal or globose, 10–12 by 10 mm, smooth; stipe ca 12 mm. Seeds fine to few, globular, 5–6 mm to elliptic, 10 by 7 by 5 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Capparis cantoniensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 3, 1991. Pg. 251. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Straggling shrub or climber; branches slender, straight, reddish pubescent when young, soon glabrous; thorns rather small, straight, 1–2 mm long. Leaves elliptic, ovate or lanceolate, 2–7.5 by 1–3.5 cm, subcoriaceous, glabrous; base acute or obtuse; apex obtuse and retuse or sometimes acute or acuminate; nerves 6–8 pairs, thin. Petiole 2–3 mm. Flowers in terminal subumbels, sometimes lateral on small twigs. Pedicels 1.5–3 cm, filiform. Sepals 4–5 by 2–4 mm; margin thin, glabrous. Petals white, oblong, 8 by 3 mm, hairy inside. Stamens 12–20. Gynophore 9–18 mm, filiform, glabrous. Ovary ovoid, 1 by 1 mm, beaked, glabrous. Fruits subglobose, ca 8 mm in diam.; stipe ca 5 cm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Capparis diffusa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 3, 1991. Pg. 254. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Shrub, 50–200 cm high; branches slender, terete, pubescent when young, soon glabrous; thorns vigorous, recurved, 2–4 mm long. Leaves ovate or sometimes elliptic, 2–8.5 by 1.5–3.5 cm, papery when young, soon subcoriaceous, paler beneath; base rounded; apex gradually acuminate with a short mucro; nerves 4–6 pairs, thin. Petiole 3–4 mm. Flowers arranged in supra-axillary rows. Pedicels 1–2 cm. Sepals elliptic, 4–5 by 2–4 mm, densely white tomentose inside, outside pubescent. Petals elliptic, 5–8 by 2 mm, densely white tomentose inside, outside pubescent; not distinctly veined. Stamens 8–10. Gynophore 1.5–2 cm long, hairy towards the base. Ovary elliptic, 2 by 1 mm, densely whitish or greyish tomentose. Fruits subglobose, 1–2 by 1–1.5 cm; more or less apiculate, densely covered with corky warts; stipe 22–28 mm. Seeds numerous; ± 8 by 6 by 4 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Climber; branches terete, densely tomentose when young, soon pubescent; thorns small, recurved, ca 1 mm long. Leaves elongate, obovate or oblong, 8–17.5 by 3–4.5 cm, subcoriaceous, glabrous, often reddish-brown when dry; base obtuse or acute; apex acuminate and mucronate; nerves 6–8 pairs, strongly curved. Petiole 5–7 mm. Flowers in subumbels arranged in terminal, leafless panicle, with peduncle about 12–20 cm. Pedicels 4–15 mm, slender, with small linear tomentose bracts at base. Sepals unequal, 4–6 by 2–3 mm, margin thin, glabrous. Petals white to greenish, sometimes tinged reddish, suborbicular, ca 6 by 4 mm. Stamens numerous. Gynophore 2–5 mm, glabrous. Ovary ovoid, 2 by 1 mm, glabrous. Fruits globose, 6–10 mm in diam.; pericarp smooth; stipe 2–2.5 cm. Seeds 1–4, 9–10 by 4–5 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Capparis erycibe. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 3, 1991. Pg. 251. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Shrub or small tree, 2–4 m high; branches densely fulvous or greyish stellate tomentose; thorns straight or slightly recurved, 1–3 mm long. Leaves obovate, elliptic or rhomboid, 1.5–3 by 1–2 cm, papery or subcoriaceous, densely fulvous tomentose, soon glabrescent; apex retuse, mucronulate or sometimes emarginate; base obtuse, cuneate or acute; nerves 3–5 pairs, the first 2 pairs radiating from the very base; reticulation obscure. Petiole 3–4 mm. Flowers solitary, axillary. Pedicels 1–3 cm. Sepals 6–8 by 4–5 mm, densely fulvous tomentose outside. Petals yellow, obovate, 8–9 by 4–6 mm, densely tomentose outside. Stamens 6–12, yellowish. Gynophore 1.5–2.5 cm, bent, fulvous tomentose. Ovary ellip-soidal or ovoid, densely fulvous tomentose. Fruits subglobose or ellipsoidal, 2.5–4 by 2–3.5 cm, apiculate, densely covered with small protuberances, grayish tomentose; pericarp 2–5 mm thick; stipe 3–3.5 cm long, 4–5 mm thick. Seeds 6–8 by 3–7 mm.

description: Woody climber; branches glabrous; thorns present, recurved, but mostly wanting. Leaves elliptic, oblong, sometimes obovate, 6–9 by 2.5–4 cm, coriaceous, shining above, usually pale green on the under surface, and dark green on the upper when dry; base obtuse or rounded, rarely cuneate; apex obtuse or rounded, with short mucro; nerves 8–12 pairs, reticulation obscure. Petiole 8–15 mm. Flowers in subumbels arranged in terminal or axillary leafy panicle. Pedicels 8–12 mm; bract linear. Sepals 4 by 3 mm; margin thin, patent and persistent after anthesis. Petals white, oblong or ovate, 3–5 by 2 mm, thin. Stamens 7–9. Gynophore 6–10 mm, fine pubescent. Ovary ovoid, 1.5–2 by 1 mm, acute, glabrous. Fruits globose, 1.5–2 cm in diam.; pericarp smooth, wrinkled when dry; stipe 12–15 mm. Seeds 1–3, 13 by 10 by 6 mm.

bibliographicCitation: Capparis floribunda. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 3, 1991. Pg. 253. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree 5–10 m high; branches tomentose when young, soon pubescent, striat; thorns small or wanting. Leaves elliptic or ovate, 5–10.5 by 2–6.5 cm, papery to subcoriaceous, sparingly tomentose on the upper surface, more densely below; base acute or cuneate; apex acute, obtuse or mucronate; nerves 8–10 pairs, parallel then arched towards the margin. Petiole 7–9 mm. Flowers in subumbels arranged in terminal leafy panicle; often in the axils of the upper leaves. Pedicels 1.5–2 cm. Sepals 5–6 by 4 mm, inner pair broadly elliptic, concave, pubescent outside. Petals white, obovate, 8 by 3 mm; narrowed towards base, ciliate at base; apex rounded. Stamens numerous. Gynophore 10–25 mm, slender, glabrous. Ovary ovoid, 2 by 1.5–2 mm, glabrous. Fruits globose, 1.2–4.5 cm in diam., pointed when young; pericarp smooth; stipe 2–4.5 cm long, 3–7 mm thick, thickened towards the top, striate. Seeds 1–6(–15), 10–13 by 6–8 mm.

description: Shrub, about 2 m high; branches slender, with dense ferrugineous, branched hairs; shoots with a few cataphylls at base; thorns small, straight, or wanting. Leaves obovate, lanceolate or oblanceolate, 7–18 by 4–6 cm, papery, coriaceous when old, with scattered ferrugineous branched hairs; base cuneate; apex acuminate or acute; nerves 6–8 pairs, arched. Petiole 8–10 mm, with narrow undulate wings. Flowers arranged in supra-axillary rows, up to 5 flowers in each axil. Pedicels ca 1 cm. Sepals oblong or elliptic, 5–6 by 3 mm, outside puberulose. Petals oblong, 6–8 by 2–2.5 mm, hairy on both sides. Gynophore ca 2 cm, glabrous. Ovary ellipsoidal, 1.5 by 1 mm, beaked, glabrous. Fruits unknown.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Capparis kerrii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 5. Part 3, 1991. Pg. 247. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Woody climber; branches pubescent, vigorous, terete; thorns recurved, 3–4 mm long, broad-based. Leaves elliptic, 16.5–22.5 by 8–13 cm, coriaceous, glabrous above, pubescent beneath; base obtuse, rounded or subcordate; apex acute; nerves 6–7 pairs, distant. Petiole 12–15 mm. Flowers in terminal raceme or sometimes lateral. Pedicels 1.5–2.5 cm, pubescent. Sepals rounded, 11–13 by 6–7 mm, coriaceous, pubescent without. Petals white, 1.5–2 by 0.5–1 cm, hairy at base. Stamens numerous. Gynophore 3.5–5.5 cm, robust, glabrous. Ovary globose, 4 by 3 mm, with a short stigmatic point, glabrous. Fruits globose or ellipsoidal, 3–7 by 2.5–5 cm; pericarp 8–8.5 mm thick; stipe woody, 4.5–6 cm long, 6–10 mm thick. Seeds unknown.

description: Shrub or small tree, 1–6 m high; branches glabrous, mostly zigzag; shootwith cataphylls at base; thorns directed upwards, 2 mm long. Leaves oblong, elliptic, ovate or sometimes rounded, 8–24 by 4–10.5 cm, papery; base obtuse to rounded or subcordate; apex obtuse, rounded, acute or slightly emarginate, with a callose mucro; coriaceous, glabrous, shining; nerves 5–10 pairs. Petiole 1–1.5 cm. Flowers arranged in supra-axillary rows, up to 7 flowers in each axil. Pedicels 1 cm, pubescent. Sepals ovate or oblong, 4–10 by 2–4 mm, subcori-aceous, ciliate. Petals oblong, 10–15 by 3–7 mm, thin, obtuse to rounded; distinctly veined, tomentose on both sides. Stamens ca 30. Gynophore 1.5–3 cm long. Ovary ovoid or ellipsoidal, 3 by 1–1.5 mm, glabrous. Fruits ellipsoid, globose or elongated, 1.5–7 by 1.5–3.5 cm; pericarp woody, coriaceous when dry; stipe 3.5–4 cm long, 3–6 mm thick. Seeds numerous, reniform, 7 by 5–6 mm.

description: Shrub, ca 1 m high; branches slightly zigzag with stellate hairs when young, soon glabrescent and densely verruculose; sometimes shoots with a few cataphylls at base; thorns straight or slightly recurved, 2–4 mm long. Leaves ovate or elliptic, 4–7 by 2–4 cm, coriaceous, with stellate hairs when young, soon glabrous, shining above; base obtuse or acute; apex acuminate or acute, mucronate; nerves 2–4 pairs. Petiole 3–4 mm. Flowers solitary, axillary. Pedicels 5–15 mm. Sepals ovate, 13 by 5 mm; acute and concave; tomentose outside. Petals white with yellow patch; obovate, 25–28 by 8 mm, tomentose outside. Stamens numerous. Gynophore 21–24 mm, tomentose. Ovary elongate, 5 by 1 mm, long beaked; both tomentose; stigma capitate. Fruits unknown.

description: Climber or straggling shrub, to 2 m; branches rather zigzag, robust, glabrous; thorns robust, strongly recurved, 2–5 mm long. Leaves elliptic, oblong or obovate, 2–6.5 by 2–3.5 cm, coriaceous, upper surface glossy, usually reddish-brown when dry; base acute or obtuse; apex retuse, rarely emarginate; nerves 5–8 pairs. Petiole 5–6 mm, minutely warty. Flowers in subumbels arranged in terminal, or axillary leafy panicles. Pedicels 7–10 mm, with subulate bracts at base. Sepals 6 by 5 mm, coriaceous, glabrous. Petals oblong, 9 by 4 mm, pubescent. Stamens numerous. Gynophore 12–13 mm, robust, glabrous. Ovary ± ovoid, pointed; both glabrous. Fruits globose, 2.5–3 cm in diam.; pericarp ca 2 mm thick, smooth; stipe ca 3 cm long, 3 mm thick. Seeds 14–19 by 10–14 mm.

description: Shrub, 2–5 m high; branches densely tomentose when young, soon glabrescent; shoots with cataphylls at base; thorns minute, straight or slightly curved upward, sometimes wanting. Leaves oblong or elliptic, 9–15 by 3.5–8.5 cm, papery to subcoriaceouS, woolly when young, soon glabrous; base acute; apex acuminate; nerves 6–8 min. Petiole 5–10 mm. Flowers in axillary fascicles. Pedicels ca 1 cm. Sepals 4 by 3 mm, woolly outside. Petals white, obovate, 6–7 by 3–4 mm, glabrous or ciliate at apex. Stamens many. Gynophore 1–1.5 cm, woolly. Ovary ovoid, 2.5 by 1 mm, gradually tapering to apex, woolly. Fruits globose or ellipsoidal, 7–12 by 7–19 mm, pointed, glabrous. Seeds 5–15(–25), 4; 6 by 5 by 4 mm.

description: Shrub, 2–8 m high, sometimes climbing; branches terete, slender; all parts densely minutely stellate, silvery or fulvous tomentose when young, glabrescent when old; thorns straight or slightly curved, 2–3 mm long, or wanting. Leaves ovate or oblong, occasionally rhomboid, 4–10.5 by 2.5–5.5 cm, papery to sub-coriaceous, more densely hairy on the flower surface than the upper; base broadly obtuse, acute or cordate; apex always abruptly acuminate with a blunt tip; nerves 4–7 pairs, arched. Petiole 4–7 mm. Flowers arranged in supra-axillary rows, 2–4 flowers in each axil. Pedicels 1–2.5 cm, slender. Sepals 4–6 by 2–4 mm, the inner pairs smaller, acute, with stellate hairs on both sides. Petals white, pale yellow or greenish, elliptic, 6–7 by 2–4 mm, apically rounded, with stellate hairs on both surfaces, ciliate; veins conspicuous. Stamens ca 30. Gynophore 1.5–2 cm, filiform, hairy towards the base. Ovary ellipsoidal or ovoid, 2 by 0.5 mm, glabrous. Fruits black when ripe, globose, 5–8 mm in diam.; pericarp thin, rugose; stipe 2.5 cm, slender. Seeds 2–6, 6 by 3–4 by 2 mm.

description: Shrub to 4 m high; branches glabrous, densely covered with minute warts; shoots with cataphylls at base; thorns strongly recurved, 3–4 mm long. Leaves oblong or ovate, 3.5–9.5 by 1.5–6.5 cm, coriaceous, glabrous; base rounded or subcordate; apex retuse; nerves 5–6 pairs. Petiole 5–6 mm, upper part densely papillose. Flowers 1–3, arranged in supra-axillary rows. Pedicels 8–13 mm. Sepals elliptic, 12 by 4 mm, acute, pubescent on both sides. Petals obovate, 14 by 4 mm, obtuse or rounded; distinctly veined. Stamens numerous. Gynophore 12–18 cm, glabrous. Ovary oblong, 4 by 1 mm, ridged, pubescent when young, soon glabrous; stigma discoid. Fruits ovoid, 4–5 by 3–4 cm; stipe ca 4 cm, curved. Seeds reniform, ca 8 by 6 mm.

description: Shrub or small tree, 1.5–4 m; branches glabrous; shoots with a few cataphylls at base; thorns straight, 3–4 mm long, or wanting. Leaves elliptic or oblong, 4.5–10 by 2–4.5 cm, papery; base acute or cuneate; apex gradually tapering to a tip, up to 2 cm, or acuminate; nerves 3–7 pairs, arched. Petiole 5–8 mm. Flowers arranged in supra-axillary rows. Pedicels 12–20 mm. Sepals 5–6 by 2–4 mm; outside glabrous; inside tomentose; ciliate in the inner pairs. Petals oblong, 7 by 2.5–3 mm, densely tomentose on both sides. Gynophore 15–20 mm, glabrous. Ovary ovoid or ellipsoidal, 2 by 1 mm, glabrous. Fruits globose, ca 1 cm in diam.; pericarp thin, smooth; stipe 2.5–4 cm slender.

description: Shrub, 2–4 m high, sometimes climbing; branches robust, zigzag, fulvousor greyish pubescent when young, soon glabrescent;.thorns strongly recurved, 2–5 mm long. Leaves elliptic, ovate or oblong, 2.5–7.5 by 1–4 cm, subcoriaceous, glabrescent beneath; base obtuse or rounded; apex obtuse or rounded and nearly retuse; nerves 3–7 pairs, reticulation obscure. Petiole 3–6 mm. Flowers in subumbels of 7–15, terminal; sometimes in the axils of the upper leaves. Pedicels 1–2.5 cm. Sepals 4–5 by 3–4 mm; outer pair more or less coriaceous; inner pair elliptic, glabrous. Petals white, oblong, 5–7 by 1–3 mm, narrowed towards base; base pubescent. Stamens numerous. Gynophore 4–10 mm, glabrous. Ovary ellipsoidal, 1–2 by 1 mm, pointed, glabrous. Fruits globose, 6–10 mm in diam.; stipe 2.5–3 cm long, thin. Seeds usually 1, 8 by 5 by 4 mm.

description: Shrub, 1.5–5 m high; branches straggling, yellowish-brown tomentose when young, soon glabrous; shoots usually with some cataphylls at base; thorns slender, recurved, 1–2 mm long. Leaves ovate, 5–10.5 by 3–4.5 cm, papery to more or less subcoriaceous, pubescent especially along the nerves and midrib; base subcordate, obtuse or rounded; apex acute and mucronate, sometimes acuminate; nerves 4–7 pairs, the first 1 or 2 pairs radiating from the very base. Petiole 7–8 mm. Flowers large, solitary, axillary. Pedicels 10–13 mm. Sepals 10–12 by 4–6 mm, densely tomentose without. Petals greenish or whitish; the upper pair with a deep-yellow blotch, fading red, obovate, 20–25 by 5–8 mm; densely tomentose towards the apex without. Stamens numerous. Gynophore 2–2.5 cm, rather robust, yellowish tomentose. Ovary ovoid, 375 by 2.5 mm, beaked, densely yellowish tomentose. Fruits ellipsoidal or ovoid, 3.5–5.5 by 2.5–3 cm, pointed; with 8 longitudinal rows of small knobs, sometimes glabrous; stipe 4–5 cm long, 4–6 mm thick, pubescent. Seeds 7–10 by 5–6 mm.

description: Shrub up to 3 m high; branches spreading, glabrous; thorns recurved, sharp, 2–3 mm long. Leaves ovate, elliptic or obovate, 4.5–6.5 by 3–7.5 cm, papery; base rounded, sometimes acute; apex abruptly acuminate; nerves usually 4 pairs, arched, reticulations inconspicuous. Petiole 4–7 mm. Flowers white, arranged in supra-axillary rows, 2–7 in each axil. Pedicels 1.5–2 cm, slender. Sepals ovate, 4–5 by 1.5–2 mm, densely tomentose inside, outside glabrous. Petals oblong, 5–7 by 1.5–2 mm, acuminate, tomentose on both sides. Stamens 8–15. Gynophore 14–18 mm long, filiform, glabrous. Ovary ovoid, 1–3 by 0.5–2 mm, beaked, glabrous. Fruits subglobose, 5–10 mm in diam, sometimes pointed; pericarp thin, smooth; stipe 3.5–4 cm, slender. Seeds 1–2, ± 5 by 4 by 3 mm.

description: Shrub or small tree, 1–5 m; branches slender, pubescent; thorns robust, strongly recurved, 3–5 mm long. Leaves broadly elliptic, 1.5–4 by 1–2.5 cm, subcoriaceous, pubescent along midrib; base obtuse or rounded; apex rounded and retuse; nerves 4–6 pairs, thin, reticulation obscure. Petiole 3–6 mm. Flowers in subumbels arranged in terminal leafy panicles. Pedicels 10–12 mm. Sepals 5–7 by 2 mm; margin thin, glabrous. Petals white, obovate, 7–8 by 3 mm; pubescent inside towards the base. Stamens ca 35. Gynophore ca 15 mm, glabrous. Ovary ovoid, 1.5 by 1 mm, pointed, glabrous. Fruit globose, 1–2.5 cm in diam; pericarp hard, shining; stipe 2–3.5 cm long, 1–4 mm thick. Seeds 1–2, 15 by 10 mm.

description: Scandent shrub or climber; branches terete, brown-pubescent when young, soon glabrous; thorns straight or slightly recurved, 1–2 mm long. Leaves oblong or elliptic, 3.5–8.5 by 1.5–3.5 cm, subcoriaeeous, glabrous on both surfaces; obscurely nerved; base acute or obtuse; apex acuminate, with a more or less retuse tip. Petiole 4–8 mm. Flowers solitary, axillary, or sometimes in terminal group of 2–4. Pedicels 1.5–2.5 cm, robust, angular, glabrous. Sepals 8–15 by 9–14 mm; outside glabrous. Petals pink or white, 1.5–2 by 7 mm, tomentose at base outside. Stamens numerous. Gynophore 3–5 cm, glabrous. Ovary ovoid, 3–3.5 by 1.5–2 mm, acute; both glabrous. Fruits globose or ellipsoidal, 3 by 2.5 cm, apiculate; pericarp ca 2 mm thick, rough; stipe about 4 cm.

description: Scandent shrub, up to 6 m; branches densely brown-tomentose; thorns recurved, 2–4 mm. Leaves ovate, elliptic, oblong or occasionally obovate, 5.5–9.5 by 2–3.5 cm, coriaceous, underneath densely brown tomentose; base obtuse or subcordate; apex acuminate; nerves 4–7 pairs, arched. Petiole 10–15 mm. Flowers in terminal corymbs. Pedicels 2–3 cm, robust. Sepals orbicular, 11–15 mm long, brown-tomentose outside. Petals violet, obovate, 12–20 by 15 mm; apex rounded; veins distinct; tomentose outside. Stamens numerous. Gynophore ca 3.5 cm, sparingly tomentose at base. Ovary globose, 3 mm in diam, glabrous. Fruits unknown.

description: Climbing shrub, 2–4 m high; branches densely ferrugineous to greyish tomentose when young, soon glabresent; thorns recurved, 1–4 mm long. Leaves ovate, elliptic, obovate or rhomboid, 5–16.5 by 2.5–10.5 cm, subcoriaceous, shining above, sometimes pubescent beneath; base obtuse, acute, rounded or subcordate; apex acute or rounded, sometimes emarginate, with a recurved stiff mucro; nerves 4–5 pairs, arched. Petiole 1–2 cm. Flowers arranged in supra-axillary rows. Pedicels 1.5–2 cm. Sepals 8–17 by 4–8 mm; inner pair elliptic or oblong, tomentose. Petals oblong, 6–10 by 4–14 mm, rounded; distinctly veined, tomentose. Stamens numerous. Gynophore 3.5–4 cm, hairy towards the base. Ovary ellipsoidal, 3 by 2 mm, glabrous. Fruits ellipsoidal or globose, 16–30 by 12–30 mm; stipe 3.5–6.5 cm, striate. Seeds numerous, 5–7 by 5–4.5 m.

description: Slender woody climber, stems hispid when young, later glabrescent. Leaves bluish, rotund-ovate, 6–9 by 5.5–8.5 cm, base very broadly rounded, apex rounded or slightly retuse; at first hispid on both surfacac, later glabrescent above, reticulation very lax; thinly papyraceous; petioles hispid, 3–6 cm, inserted 8–15 mm from basal margin of lamina. Male inflorescence narrowly thyrsoid, 2.5–5 cm long, hispid. Male flowers glabrous, yellowish-green, on pedicels, 2–3 mm; sepals obovate, 2 mm long; corolla dish-shaped, undulate, 0.75 mm long; synandrium 2 mm long, with 4(–6), anther-cells. Female inflorescences subracemose, 6–10.5 cm long, hispid, flowers in fascicles of 4–5 subtended by a broadly ovate bract, 3–4 mm long. Female flowers glabrous, on pedicels, 1 mm; sepals 2, lateral, opposite, concave-elliptic, 1.5 mm long; petals 2, episepalous, broadly obovate, 0.75 mm long; carpels 1.5 mm long, including style with spreading lobes. Infructescences with accrescent bracts, broadly obcordate, 9–17 by 12–25 mm, hispid. Drupes on slender pedicels, 4–5 mm hispid, subrotynd in outline. 4 mm diam.; endocarp dorsally ornamented with irregular papilliform tubercles arranged, ± in 4 longitudinal rows.

description: Annual herb; stem angular, all parts with scattered pale, appressed, basally swollen hairs. Leaflets 3–7; obovate or oblanceolate, 3–6 by 0.7–0.8 mm; base cuneate; apex acute or rounded; nerves 4–5 pairs. Petiole 2–5 cm. Flowers pink. Pedicels 2.5–4 cm. Sepals ovate, 3–4 by 1.5–2 mm, acuminate. Petals obovate, 12–15 by 3–5 mm glabrous; base attenuate; apex rounded. Stamens numerous; filaments thickened at the top; anthers oblong. Gynophore absent. Ovary linear, 5–10 mm long, beaked, glabrous. Fruits 4.5–8 by 0.2–0.4 cm, parallel veined, glabrous; stipe 3–4 cm. Seeds 1.5 mm in diam., brown, irregularly verrucate.

description: Annual herb, up to 1 m high; all parts glandular pubescent. Leaflets 5, obovate-oblanceolate, 2.5–5 by 0.5–2.5 cm; base cuneate; apex acute or obtuse; entire or serrulate; nerves 5–9 pairs. Petiole 3–8 cm. Bracts small, leaf-like, 3-foliolate. Flowers white or tinged with purple; pedicels 1–2 cm. Sepals lanceolate, 3–6 by 1–2 mm. Petals elliptic or spathulate, 4–7 by 2–3 mm, with 3–4 mm claw. Androgynophore 8–23 mm, soon glabrous. Stamens 6; filaments 1–2 cm; anthers oblong, 2–3 mm long. Gynophore 1–2 mm in flower, extending to 11 mm in fruit, glabrous. Ovary cylindrical, 1.5–2.5 by 0.5 mm, elongate, glandular pubescent. Fruits 3–7.5 by 0.4–0.5 cm, tapering at both ends; stipe 4–5 cm. Seeds 1–1.5 mm in diam., black-brown, with short irregular cross-ribs and inconspicuous longitudinal ribs.

description: Annual herb; all parts with scattered soft, whitish hairs, ca 1 mm long. Leaflets 3, ovate, subrhombic or lanceolate, 3–3.5 by 1–1.5 cm; base cuneate; apex acute; nerves 6–8 pairs. Petiole 3–3.5 cm. Flowers violet; buds oblong, ca 4 mm long. Pedicels 2–3 cm, filiform. Sepals ovate, 2.5–3 mm long; apex acute or acuminate. Petals obovate, 8–11 by 2.5–3 mm, clawed. Stamens 6; filaments 7–10 mm; anthers oblong, ca 2 mm long. Gynophore ca 1.5 mm. Ovary cylindrical, 5–7 mm long, curved, beaked. Fruits 4.5–6 by 0.3–0.4 cm, with parallel veins, glabrous; stipes 2.5–3 om. Seeds 1.5 mm in diam., brown, with conspicuous, ± anastomosing cross-ribs connected by much weaker longitudinal ribs; a whitish elaiosome present.

description: Annual herb, up to 1 m high; all parts, ± densely brownish glandular pubescent and viscid throughout. Leaflets 3–5; obovate or ovate, 1.5–4.5 by 1–1.5 cm; base cuneate; apex acute or obtuse; nerves 5–6 pairs. Petiole 1.5–6 cm. Flowers yellow. Pedicels ca 1 cm. Sepals lanceolate or oblong, 6–7 by 1–2 mm, acuminate. Petals spathulate or oblong, 7–10 by 3–5 mm; base cuneate into short claw, glabrous. Stamens many; filaments 5–7 mm; anthers linear, 1–2 mm long. Gynophore absent. Ovary 5–10 mm long. Fruits 4–9 by 2–3 mm, narrowed to the apex, with distinct veins, hairy; stipe 1–3 cm. Seeds ca 1 mm in diam., red-brown, with conspicuous anastomosing cross-ribs and weak longitudinal ribs.

description: Slender climber; stems pubescent to tomentose. Leaves ovate to elliptic, 1.5–4.5 by 0.7–3.3 cm, base cuneate to truncate, apex obtuse to slightly retuse and with a fine mucro; villous to sparsely pubescent above, densely villous beneath, papyraceous; petiole 2–11 mm, tomentose. Inflorescence an axillary fascicle of 2–3 few-flowered, peduncled congested cymules, 3–7 mm long, sometimes arising along a young axillary shoot, thus appearing subracemose, villous. Male flowers with pedicels, 0.5–1 mm; sepals in 2 whorls of 3, pilose; outer 3 narrow, 1 mm long; inner 3, ± obovate, 1.25–1.5 mm long; petals 6, apex 2-lobed, 0.75–1 mm long, glabrous; stamens 6, 0.75 mm long. Female flowers: sepals and petals similar to male; staminodes absent; carpels 3, 1 mm long. Drupes obliquely subobovate in outline, ca 4 mm long; endocarp with prominent median dorsal ridge and branched radial dorsal ridges, mch side with a large aperture.

description: Erect shrub or tree up to 6 m; branchlets glabrous. Leaves elliptic or oblanceolate-elliptic, 7–11(–15) by 3–5.5 cm, base usually acute, occasionally cuneate, apex acute, often rather attenuate, base strongly 3-nerved with the basal nerves, running almost parallel to the margin beyond the middle of the lamina, both surfaces glabrous, stiffly papyraceous; petiole 3–6(–10) mm. Male inflorescences axillary, composed of cymes arranged in a thyrse, or sometimes consisting of a single cyme, 0.5–4 cm long, glabrous or sparsely puberulous. Male flowers yellow, glabrous throughout, on pedicels up to 1 mm; sepals in 2 whorls of 3, all ± broadly elliptic; outer sepals, 0.5–0.75 mm long; inner sepals, 1–1.25 mm long; petals 6, cuneate, apex emarginate or divided into 2 rounded lobes, 0.5 mm long; stamens 6, 0.75 mm long. Female inflorescences similar to male, but fewer-flowered thus appearing subracemose. Female flowers on pedicels, up to 5 mm; sepals and petals as in male; staminodes 6, minute; carpels 3, 1 mm long; styles reflexed. Drupes rotund in outline, ca 4 mm diam., glabrous; endocarp with a small curved aperture on both sides, finely ridged over the dorsal surface.

description: Slender climber; stems pubescent to subglabrous. Leaves elliptic to ovate-elliptic, 3–10 by 1–5.5 cm, base usually obtuse to truncate, apex usually rounded, sometimes emarginate; both surfaces sparsely pubescent to glabrous, papyraceous; petiole puberulous, 5–10(–20) mm. Male inflorescences axillary and terminal, the flowers in peduncled cymes, 0.8–1.5 cm long, which are often solitary when axillary, or arranged in a narrow thyrse, up to 7 cm, yellowish pubescent. Male flowers white, glabrous throughout, on pedicels, 1–2 mm; sepals in 3 whorls of 3; outermost whorl minute, often incomplete; middle whorl, up to 1 mm long; inner whorl with sepals obovate to rotund, 1–2.5 mm long; petals 6, ± oblong with the apex divided into 2 acute lobes, 1–1.5 mm long; stamens 6, 1 mm long. Female inflorescences axillary and terminal, much fewer-flowered than the male, appearing racemose, up to 5 cm long. Female flowers on bracteolate “pedicels”, ca 5 mm long (i.e. glabrous pedicel + puberulous inflorescence-branch); sepals and petals as in male; staminodes 6, minute, glabrous; carpels 6, glabrous, 0.75 mm long. Drupes dark blue, rotund in outline, 4–5 mm diam., glabrous; endocarp with a small curved aperture on both sides, dorsally ornamented with branched ridges.

description: Leaves, ± ovate (in Thailand), 12–35 by 6–20 cm, base broadly rounded or truncate, apex acuminate to rounded, upper surface glabrous, often drying, bullate, flower surface whitish tomentellous, palmately 7–11-nerved, at base with 2–3 pairs of distal lateral nerves, thinly coriaceous; petiole 6–20 cm, inserted 1.5–5 cm from basal margin of lamina. Inflorescences: flowers in globose, densely and ∞-flowered heads, 10–13 mm diam. on peduncles, 10–25 mm, arranged in a raceme, 12–14 mm; bracts inconspicuous, scale-like, 1–2 mm long. Male flowers with pedicels, 1.5–2 mm; the inner sepals 3–6, spreading at anthesis, broadly elliptic to spathulate-obovate, 2.5–3 mm long; the outermost 3 elliptic, 1.5–2 mm long, inserted flower; stamens 6, 1 mm long. Female flowers: inner sepals 6, oblong to oblanceolate, 4–4.5 mm long; staminodes 6; carpels 3, as in C. fenestratum. Drupes tomentose to glabrescent in young state, other-wise unknown.

description: Leaves usually broadly ovate or ovate, rarely subpanduriform with basal, lateral lobes, 11–33 by 8–23 cm, base broadly rounded, truncate or shallowly cordate, rarely broadly obtuse, apex acuminate, upper surface glabrescent, usually drying smooth, midrib and other main nerves sunken; flower surface often whitish tomentellous, palmately 5–7-nerved at base and also usually two pairs of distal lateral nerves thinly coriaceous; petiole 3–16 cm, inserted up to 0.8(–2.7) cm from basal margin of lamina. Inflorescences: flowers in several-flowered, globose heads, 6–7 mm diam., on peduncles 10–30 mm, arranged in a raceme 5–11 cm, Inflorescences arising singly or a few together; bracts subulate, 4–5 mm long. Male flowers sessile or with pedicels, up to 1 mm; sepals broadly elliptic to obovate; the inner 3–6 spreading, yellow, 1.5–2 mm long; the outermost smaller, 1–1.5 mm long, inserted flower; stamens 6, 1 mm long. Female flowers: sepals as in male flowers; staminodes 6, claviform, 1 mm long; carpels 3, curved-ellipsoidal, 2 mm long, densely pilose; style filiform, recurved. Infructescences with carpophore globose, tomentellous, 7–8 mm diam., bearing 1–3 drupes. Drupes subglobose, tomentellous, brown to orange or yellowish, 2.8–3 cm diam.; pericarp drying woody, ca 1 mm thick; endocarp bony, 2.2–2.5 cm diam., wall 3 mm thick covered with anastomosing fibrous ridges; condyle deeply intrusive, thickly clavate. Seeds whitish, subglobose, enveloping the condyle.

description: Shrub 2 m to tree 25 m. Leaflets twice as long as wide; petiolule 3–8 mm; elliptic or ovate, 2–10 by 2–6 cm, subcoriaceous, mostly concolorous or slightly paler beneath; base acute to cuneate; usually bluntish acuminate with more or less obtuse apex, sometimes rounded; nerves 5–7 pairs. Petiole 7–9 cm. Flowers few, axillary, towards the top. Pedicels 4–8 cm; Sepals elliptic, 3–6 by 2–3 mm, mostly orange when dried. Petals white, turning yellow; blade elliptic, 1.5–2.5 by 0.5–1 cm; claw 3–7 mm. Stamens purple, filament ca 4 cm. Gynophore usually 5 cm. Ovary 2.5–3 by 2 mm. Fruits globose, 2–3.5 cm in diam.; pericarp red-violet-brownish tinged, at least when dry, smooth throughout; stipe 5–13 cm long, 2–4 cm thick. Seeds smooth, comparatively small, ca 8–9 by 7 by 6 mm.

description: Tree 4–15 m high. Leaflets 3 times as long as wide; petiolule 5–7 mm; elliptic or lanceolate, 4.5–18 by 1.5–6.5 cm, subcoriaceous when mature, paler beneath; base acute to cuneate; apex gradually acuminate with acute tip, up to 2.5 cm; nerves 9–20 pairs; prominent beneath, usually reddish or brown when dry; reticulations conspicuous. Petiole 5–10 cm. Flowers numerous, in terminal racemes. Pedicels 4–5 cm. Sepals ovate, 2–3.5 by 1.5–2 mm acute. Petals white turning yellow; blade suborbicular or elliptic, 2–3 by 1–2.5 cm, claw 0.5–1 cm. Stamens purple, filaments 3.5–6.5 cm. Gynophore 3.5–8 cm. Ovary ellip-soidal 0r cylindrical, 4–6 by 1–2 mm. Fruits ellipsoidal, 2–6 by 1.5–4.5 cm; pericarp roughish, whitish; stipe 8–13 cm long, 3–5 mm thick. Seeds 6–11 mm in diam., dull dark brown.

description: Tree to 20 m high. Leaves clustered towards the end of branches. Leaflets 2 times as long as wide, mostly subsessile or petiolule not longer than 3 mm; elliptic or ovate, 5.5–16 by 2.5–7 cm, usually thin initially; base acute; apex acute or rather abruptly acuminate; nerves 5–9 pairs, distant, regularly arched, reticulations inconspicuous. Petiole 6. 5–13 cm. Flowers many. Pedicels 4–7 cm Sepals elliptic or ovate, obtuse or little acuminate, 5–6 by 2–3 mm. Petals white, turning yellow; blade broadly elliptic, acute to obtuse, 1.5–3.5 by 0.5–2 cm; claw 3–10 mm. Stamens reddish or purple, filament 1.5–5 cm. Gynophore up to 5.5 cm. Ovary ellipsoidal or ovate, 3–5 by 1–3 mm. Fruits mostly elongate to subglobose, 2–20 by 3–9.5 cm; pericarp greyish when dry; mostly roughish with dry flat papillae. Seeds 5–12 mm in diam.

description: Slender woody climber, 2–5 m, stems densely covered with a mixture ofyellow hairs, ca 2 mm long, together with much shorter hairs eventually glabrescent. Leaves not peltate, deltoid ovate, 11–14 by 9–10 cm, base cordate to truncate, apex acuminate; upper surface softly pubescent especially along the nerves, flower surface puberulous to pilose; thinly papyraceous; petioles 6–8.5 cm long, covered with both long and short hairs. Male inflorescences axillary or on older, leafless stems, narrowly thyrsoid, 4.5 cm long, 0.8 cm broad, yellowish pubescent, flowers in short lateral cymes. Male flowers on 1–2 mm pedicels; sepals 4, greenish-white, shonly connate at the base, oblong, 2 mm long, externally pilose; corolla reduced to a fleshy disc 0.25 mm long; synandrium 1 mm long. Female inflorescences similar to male, but larger. Female flowers on pedicels 0.5 mm long; sepals 2, greenish-white, subopposite, elliptic. 1 mm long, externally pilose; petals 2, episepalous, broadly obovate, 0.25 mm long, fleshy; carpels subellipsoidal, 1 mm long, puberulous becorning hispid; stigma with 4–5 spreading, subulate lobes. Infmctmnces on older, leafless stems, up to 19 by 2.5 cm, with the drupes crowded on short lateral branches. Drupes red, very shortly pedicellate or sessile, covered with both long and short hairs, rotund in outline, 5 mm diam.; endocarp bearing 6 dorsal rows of tubercles.

description: Slender climber, up to ca 5 m; roots thick and long; stems herbaceous orwoody, hispid when young, later glabrescent. Leaves ovate, deltoid-ovate or broadly ovate, 6–17.5 by 4–12.5 cm, base slightly emarginate, truncate or roun-ded, apex acutely acuminate to obtuse, with a finely mucronate acumen, margin often hispid, hispid to subglabrous above, puberulous to tomentose below, occasionally hispid along nerves, papyraceous; petioles hispid, 3–6.5 cm, attached 6–25 mm above the basic of lamina. Male inforescencas axillary or cauliflorous, 7–12(–30) by 0.5–4(–12) cm, puberulous; flowers in spaced, dense, subca-pitate, hairy clusters, borne on short lateral branches, 1–4(–7) cm. Male flowers with pedicels, 1–2 mm; calyx greenish, campanulate, pilose, 1.5–2 mm long; lobes 4 (or 5), triangular, about half the length of tube; corolla gamo-petalous, cupulaI, margin truncate or obtusely lobed, 0.75 mm long, glabrous; synandrium 1.5–2 mm long, usually exserted. Female inflorescences similar to male but usually broader, 11–19 by 3–7 cm. Female flowers sessile in dense heads; sepals 2, rhomboid to obovate, 0.5 mm long and broad, pilose on outer surface; petals 2, ± reniform, opposite to and much broader than sepals, 0.5 by 0.75–1 mm, glabrous; carpels 1 mm long, densely pilose; stigma 3-laciniate. Drupes white, obliquely obovate to rounded in outline, 5–7 by 4–5.5 mm, puberulous; endocarp bearing 4 dorsal rows of papilliform tubercles, and a lateral subentire curved ridge bordering the condyle on each side.

description: Slender climber, up to ca 15 m, stems hispid to glabrous, herbaceous or slightly woody. Leaves peltate, triangular-ovate, deltoid-ovate or broadly ovate, 9–16 by 5–13.5 cm, base truncate to slightly emarginate, apex acutely acuminate with acumen finely mucronate, margin usually hispid; sparsely hispid to glabrescent above, fairly densely hispid to puberulous or subtomentose below, papyraceous; petioles usually hispid, (1.3–)4–6.2 cm, attached 8–22 mm above the base of the lamina. Male inflorescence: axillary; flowers borne in clusters on a lax thyrse, 15–55 by 10–20 cm, puberulous. Male flowers with pedicels, 1–2 mm; calyx white or cream, campanulate, glabrous, 1–1.5 mm long; lobes 4, broadly triangular, about half the length of tube; petals 4, free, 0.5 mm long, glabrous; synandrium ca 1 mm long, shortly exserted. Female inflorescences cauliflorous (± always), similar to male, 10–35 by 2.5–10 cm. Female flowers on pedicels, ca 0.5 mm, petals and sepals unknown (± early caducous); carpels 1 mm long, pilose or glabrous; stigma with 3 filiform, divaricate lobes. Drupes white, obliquely obovate to rotund in outline, 5–8 by 4–6 mm, sparsely pubescent; endocarp bearing 3 rows of papilliform tubercles on both faces.

description: Woody climber, stems hispid when young, later developing a fissured bark. Leaves slightly peltate or subpeltate, triangular-ovate to. broadly cordate, 11–19 by 7.5–16 cm, base mostly cordate, apex acuminate, glabrous above, pubescent to hispid below, reticulation fine and raised on both surfaces; papyraceous; petiole 3–8 cm, hispid, attached up to ca 2(–8) mm above the base of lamina. Inflorescences borne on old, leafless stems, broadly thyrsoid, pubescent, 10–18 cm long; lateral branches up to 8 cm long. Male flowers on pedicels articulated towards the apex, 0.5–1 mm; calyx depressed globose-urceolate, obscurely crenulate at the constricted mouth, 1.5 mm long, 2.5 mm broad, glabrous, fleshy; petals 4, subulate, 1 mm long; synandrium slightly exsert, 1.5 mm long. Female flowers: sepals 2, opposite, deeply concave, sacciform, 1 mm long, fleshy, glabrous; petals 2, each within a sepal, minute, ca 0.3 mm long; concave-cucullate; carpels ovoid, 1 mm long; stigma shortly 3-lobed. Drupes rotund in outline, 5 mm diam., glabrous (in Thailand), the ornamentation of the endocarp clearly visible under the pericarp when dry; endocarp bearing 6 dorsal to lateral rows of prominent, peg-like or papilliform tubercles.

description: Slender woody climber, stems pubescent. Leaves peltate, ovate to triangular-ovate, 6–14 by 4.5–10 cm, base truncate to cordate, apex usually rounded at the tip and mucronate, the margin often irregularly and broadly crenate, lightly to sparsely pubescent above; pubescent to subtomentose below, lax reticulation raised on upper surface; thinly papyraceous; petiole pubescent, 2.5–10 cm, attached (1–)4–15 mm above the base of lamina. Male inflorescences axillary or terminal on short lateral shoots, narrowly thyrsoid, 2–9 cm long, pubescent; flowers in dense cymose clusters. Male flowers on pedicels, up to 1 mm, articulated towards the apex; sepals 4, green or white, slightly joined at base, elliptic to obovate, 2–2.5 mm long, thin, glabrous; corolla a fleshy cup, sublobed at the apex, sometimes partly divided, 1 mm long; synandrium becoming exsert, 2 mm long. Female inflorescences shorter than male. Female flowers (only young complete flowers seen): sepals 2, opposite, concave; petals 2, minute, one within each petal; carpels gibbous-ovoid; stigma acutely 3-lobed. Drupes white, rotund in outline, 4 mm diam., glabrous; the endocarp ornamentation obscurely visible through pericarp when dry, endocarp with rugulose ornamentation in dorsal and lateral bands.

description: Large woody climber, totally glabrous, stem up to 20 cm diam., finelystriate when young. Leaves usually not peltate, broadly ovate to suborbicular, 6–11 by 6–11 cm, base rounded to cordate, apex rounded to acute; fine reticulation more obvious on the sometimes glaucous flower surface, margin sometimes broadly and shallowly crenate; papyraceous; petiole 5–12 cm long. Inflorescences cauliflorous, up to 52 cm long and 7 cm wide. Flowers fragrant. Male flowers pale yellow with pedicels, 2–4 mm long; sepals 6, strongly marked (when dry) by a dark brown reticulum; outer 3 elliptic, 2.5 mm long, inner 3 broadly elliptic, 2.5 mm long; petals 6, ovate-rhombic, 1 mm long; apex acute or emarginate; stamens 6, 2 mm long; anthers dehiscing with a transverse slit. Female flowers: sepals and petals as in male; staminodes 6, filamentose; carpels 2 mm long. Drupes yellow to orange; endocarp elongate, ± narrowly obovate in outline, slightly curved, 14–20 mm long, 8–11 mm broad, dorsally ornamented with many transverse ridges, lacking a median dorsal ridge.

description: Large woody climber, up to ca 40 m, stem containing white latex. Leaves elliptic, elliptic-ovate to ovate or oblong-elliptic, (9–)11–21(–28) by (3.5–)5–14 cm, base sometimes subpeltate, usually rounded, apex acuminate, often shortly so, upper surface often drying greyish and smooth with reticulation obscure; thinly coriaceous; petiole (2–)4–13 cm, often drying blackish at least at the swollen base. Inflorescences axillary or ramiflorous, ca 10–38 cm, with lateral branches, up to 12 cm. Male flowers sweetly scented, on pedicels, up to 5 mm or sessile; main sepals white or yellow, broadly elliptic, concave, 2.5–4 mm long; stamens 6, 2–2.5 mm long; filament thickly columnar, incurved. Female flowers: sepals and petals as in male; staminodes subulate, 2 mm; carpels ellipsoidal, 1.75 mm long; stigma cleft-like, small. Infructescences often ramiflorous, up to ca 55 cm. Drupes yellow to orange on pedicels, 6–15 mm; endocarp 2–2.5 cm long, wall ca 1 mm thick, hard and rigid.

description: Branchlets slightly puberulous or glabrous. Leaves elliptic, slightly ovate-elliptic or obovate-elliptic, rounded or obtuse at the base, acuminate (or rounded) at the apex, 7–16 by 3–8.5 cm, glabrous, nervation mostly prominent; petioles 1.2–3.5 cm. Inflorescences axillary, cauliflorous (or terminal) paniculate or subracemose, puberulous or glabrous, up to 50 cm long, with lateral branches up to 9 cm. Male flowers on pedicels 2–4 mm; sepals the outer ones minute (less than 1 mm long), ciliate; the inner ones larger, elliptic, 3 mm long, glabrous; petals ± broadly elliptic, 1.5–2 mm long; stamens 1 mm long, with the connective much swollen on the adaxial side. Female flowers: sepals and petals as in male flowers; staminodes rod-like, 0.5 mm; carpels ovoid-ellipsoidal, 1 mm long; style sharply reflexed. Drupes red, obovoid-ellipsoidal, glabrous, 4.5 by 2.5 cm; embryo 3.5 cm long (measurements from material in alcohol).

description: Shrub or small tree, up to 10 m tall. Flower surface of leaves often more densely pubescent than in ssp. benghalensis.

description: Straggling shrub; young branches yellowish hairy, glabrescent, reddish-brown. Leaves ovate, ovate-elliptic to ovatc-oblong, (4.5–)6–12(–14.5) by 3–8.5 cm; apex mucronate or acuminate, rarely obtuse; base rounded to sub-cordate, often with 2 basal glands; upper surface tomentose when young, glabrescent; flower surface tomentose, nerves more prominent; lateral veins 5–7 pairs; petiole tomentose when young, 5–10 mm long. Inflorescences pale yellowish hairy, 4–13 cm long; peduncle 9–1.5 cm long; pedicels hirsute, ca 8–12 mm long, articulate about the middle; bracts triangular, ca 3 by 1.5–2 mm; bracteoles acute, 1–2 mm long. Flowers: calyx glands orbicular, often less than 1 mm in diam., usually 2 on each lobe. Sepals ovate or oblong; apex rounded; base truncate, 2.5–3 by 2 mm. Petals white, with patches of yellow at the base, suborbicular; base truncate or cuneate; margin crenate-dentate, claw 1–1.5 mm; limb ca 8 by 6 mm. Stamens: often fine filament broader, ca 3 mm long; the slender filaments, 4–5 mm long; anthers 1.5–2 mm long. Ovary ca 2 mm in diam., style ca 3 mm long, glabrous. Mericarps white, long hairy; the middle wing obovate, apex rounded or slightly lobed, 1.7–2 by 0.8–1 cm; lateral wings oblong, 1–1.3 by 0.5 ~0.6 cm, mostly without a dorsal crest.

description: Scrambling shrub; young branches yellowish hairy, glabrescent. Leaves elliptic or ovate, 3–10.5 by 1–4.5 cm; apex mucronate or acuminate, rarely rounded; base rounded rarely subcordate; young leaves yellowish pubescent; mature leaves glabrous; margin dark-coloured; upper surface shiny; flower surface without basal glands and marginal gland dots, often with 1 or 2 pairs of dark-coloured laminal glands near base; lateral veins 5–7 pairs; petiole not thickened, yellowish hairy when young, glabrescent, 6–10 mm long. Inflorescences yellowish hairy, up to 12 cm; peduncle 1–2.5 cm; pedicels pubescent, in flower 0.4–1.5 cm long, in fruit 1.5–2 cm long, articulate below the middle; bracts lanceolate, ca 2 mm long; bracteoles acute, ca 1 mm long. Flowers: calyx glands small, inconspicuous, sometimes absent. Sepals elliptic, apex rounded; base truncate, ca 1.5 by 0.8 mm. Petals white, suborbicular; apex rounded; base truncate or auriculate; margin slightly crenate, ciliate; claw 1–2 mm long; limb 3.5–4 by 3.5–4 mm. Stamens: filaments 1–2.5 mm; anthers 0.5–1 mm. Ovary ca 1 mm in diam.; style ca 4 mm long, glabrous. Mericarps yellowish hairy, more sparsely towards the apex, chartaceous; middle wing oblong, apex 2-lobed or rounded, 2–2.5 by 0.5–0.8 cm; lateral wings oblong, 1–1.2 by 0.3–0.5 cm.

description: Straggling shrub; branches glabrous; axillary buds covered with long brown hairs. Leaves elliptic or elliptic-oblong, rarely lanceolate, 5–9.5 by 2.5–3.5 cm, glabrous; flower surface mostly with 2 basal glands; margin light-coloured and without marginal gland dots; lateral veins 4–6 pairs; petiole glabrous, 5–8 mm long. Inflorescences 5–14 cm long, brown hairy; peduncle 1–2 cm long; pedicels brown hairy, articulate at middle or above, when older geniculate at the thickened articulation, in flower 12–15 mm, in fruit 14–20 mm; bracts lanceolate, 1–2 by 1 mm; bracteoles acute, 1–1.5 mm long. Flowers: calyx glands minute, inconspicuous. Sepals orbicular, recurved, ca 2 mm in diam. Petals white, oblong; apex rounded; base truncate or auriculate; margin fimbriate; claw ca 2 mm long; limb ca 9 by 7–9 mm. Stamens: the longest filament ca 1 cm long, the short ones 4–5 mm long; anthers ca 1.5 mm long. Ovary 1.5–2 mm in diam.; style ca 1 cm long, glabrous. Mericarps glabrous, except at the centre, sparsely red-brown hairy; middle wing elliptic-oblong or oblan-ceolate-oblong; apex rounded or lobed, ca 1.5 by 0.8 cm; lateral wings, ca 2 by 0.8 cm; dorsal crest, winged, ca 5–8 by 1–2 mm.

description: Woody climber; branches appressed yellow hairy, glabrescent. Leaves elliptic-oblong or ovate-oblong, 3–5 by 1–2 cm; apex acute to acdminate; base obtuse or cuneate; young leaves with a dense caducous pubescence, often with 2 basal glands; upper surface shiny; lateral veins 6–9 pairs; petioles hairy, 3–7 mm long. Inflorescences ca 2–3 cm long, pale yellowish hairy; peduncle mostly less than 1 cm; pedicels yellow pubescent, articulate at the middle, 6–10 mm; bracts lanceolate, ca 1–5 mm long; bracteoles lanceolate, 1.2–1.5 mm long. Flowers: Calyx gland (rarely more than one), conspicuous, ovate or suborbicular often concave, 1.5–2 mm in diam., adnate to the base of the calyx, sometimes decurrent on the pedice 1. Sepals oblong, apex rounded; base truncate, ca 2 by 1 mm. Petals orbicular or ovate; apex rounded; base auriculate; margin serrate-crenete, ciliate, claw 1–1.5 mm; limb 6 by 5–6 mm. Stamens: the longest filament ca 7–9 mm; the short ones, 3–5 mm long; anthers 0.5–0.7 mm. Ovary 2–3 mm in diam., style 6–8 mm long, hairy. Mericarps yellowish or whitish hairy, coriaceous; the middle wing obovate-oblong, apex rounded, irregularly crenate or lobed, 1–1.4 cm long; lateral ones oblong, 0.5–1 cm long with a short dorsal crest.

description: Woody climber; branches glabrous. Leaves elliptic or elliptic-oblong, 5.5–13.5 by 2–4.5 cm; apex acuminate, or obtuse; base rounded or cuneate; both surfaces glabrous; upper shiny, often with 2 basal glands; margin light coloured, without marginal gland dots; lateral veins, 5–8 pairs; petiole glabrous, ca 1 cm long. Inflorescences up to 6 cm long, yellowish hairy; peduncle short, 1–3 mm long; pedicels glabrous, except below the articulation, articulate at the middle, in flower ca 2.5 mm long, in fruit ca 5 mm long; bracts triangular, keeled, 1.5–2 mm long; bracteoles triangular, keeled, ca 1 mm long. Flowers: calyx glands inconspicuous. Sepals oblong; apex rounded; base truncate, 1–1.5 by 0.5–1 mm. Petals caducous, delicate, oblong; apex rounded; base cuneate and decurrent; margin slightly crenate; claw ea 1 mm long; limb ca 3 by 1 mm. Stamens: the longest filament ca 3 mm; the short ones, 1–1. 5 mm; anthers ca 0.5 mm long. Ovary 0.5–1 mm in diam; style 3–4 mm long, glabrous. Mericarps sparsely hairy at the centre; middle wing oblong; apex mostly 2-lobed, 15–19 by 3–5 mm; lateral wings, 5–7 by 2–3 mm.

description: Straggling shrub; branches glabrous. Leaves elliptic-oblong, 7–12 by(2.5–)3–4.5 cm, brownish hairy when young, glabrescent; upper surface shiny; margin recurved; flower surface sometimes with marginal gland dots; basal glands absent, mostly with 1–4 pairs of laminal gland dots, particularly on flower part; apex acuminate, rarely acute or mucronate; base cuneate to obtuse; veins 4–10 pairs; petiole glabrous, ca 5–8 mm long. Inflorescences 4–5 cm long, brownish pubescent; peduncle 1.5–2 cm long; pedicels pubescent, articulate at the middle, in flower ca 0.7–1 cm long; bracts triangular, 1–2 mm long; bracteoles acute, ca 1 mm long. Flowers: calyx glands very small, inconspicuous, or sometimes absent. Sepals lanceolate or ovate-oblong; apex acute; base truncate, ca 2 by 1 mm. Petals oblong, ciliate; apex obtuse or rounded; base truncate or auriculate; claw 0.5–0.8 mm; limb 4–5 by 1.5–2 mm. Stamens: filaments, 1.5–4 mm long; anthers 0.7–1 mm long, often fine distinctly largest. Ovary ca 0.5 mm in diam.; style ca 1 mm long, the other two styles slightly developed, ca fine third or half as long as the longest one. Schizocarps (not seen).

description: Woody climber; branches glabrous, shiny; nodes sparsely white hairy; buds pubescent. Leaves elliptic or elliptic-oblong, 5.5–11.5 by 1.5 cm; apex acuminate or mucronate; base rounded, glabrous, mostly with 2 basal glands; lower surface often with marginal gland dots; lateral veins 4–7(–8) pairs; petiole glabrous, ca 5 mm long. Inflorescences up to 14 cm long; peduncle and rachis glabrous, or rarely sparsely white hairy; peduncle ca 2 cm long; pedicels glabrous, or rarely sparsely white hairy, 1–2.2 cm, articulate mostly below the middle; bracts triangular, ca 2 by 1 mm; bracteoles acute, ca 1 mm long. Flowers: calyx glands very small, inconspicuous. Sepals ovate to oblong; apex acute to rounded; base truncate, ca 2.5 by 1.2 mm. Petals pink, obovate or suborbicular; apex rounded; base truncate or cuneate; margin fimbriate; claw 1.5–2.5 mm; limb 8–10 by 7–8 mm. Stamens: the longest filament ca 8–9 mm, the short ones 3–5 mm long; anther ca 1 mm long. Ovary ca 2 mm in diam; style ca 1 cm long, glabrous. Mericarps mostly glabrous; sometimes sparsely white hairy; middle wing oblong, apex rounded or lobed, 3–4.5 by 0.7–1.2 cm; hateral wings 1.5–2.2 by 0.6–1 cm.

description: Woody climber; branches glabrous. Leaves elliptic to elliptic-oblong, rarely oblanceolate, 6.5–13 by 3–6.5 cm; apex acuminate; base rounded; upper surface glabrous, shiny; flower surface glabrescent, or sparsely brownish hairy, often with 2 basal glands, rarely with marginal gland dots; lateral veins 6–7 pairs; petiole glabrescent. Inflorescences (not seen), infructescence ca 4–6 cm long, brownish hairy; peduncle ca 1 cm long; pedicels brownish hairy, articulate at the middle, 1.2–1.5 cm long; bracts triangular, 1.5–2 mm long; bracteoles acute, 0.4–.1 mm long. Flowers: calyx glands absent. Sepals oblong; apex rounded; base truncate, ca 2.5 by 1 mm. Petals (not seen). Ovary: style glabrous, ca 4 mm long. Mericarps brownish hairy, particularly at the centres; middle wing oblong, apex mostly irregularly, 2-lobed, or sometimes acute; lateral wings hardly developed, sometimes only fine slightly developed, up to 5 mm long.

description: Shrub; branches glabrous, yellow-brown hairy when young. Leaves elliptic to elliptic-oblong, rarely obovate, 3–7 by 1–3 cm; apex obtuse, rarely mucronate; base obtuse to cuneate; young leaves white hairy, older glabrous, often with 2 basal glands; flower surface mostly with marginal gland dots; lateral veins 5–8 pairs; petiole glabrescent, 4–5 mm. Inflorescences 4–10 cm, yellowish hairy; peduncle 5–10(–12) mm long; pedicels yellowish tomentose, in flowers 3–5 mm long, in fruits ca 8 mm long, articulate below the middle; bracts lanceolate, 2–4 mm long; bracteoles linear-lanceolate, 1–2 mm long. Flowers: calyx gland prominent, (rarely 2), oblong, linear or obovate, sometimes convex, at base of calyx lobe, sometimes decurrent on pedicel, 1.5–3 by 0.7–1 mm. Sepals oblong, apex rounded; base truncate, ca 4 by 1 mm. Petals white or pale yellow; ovate-oblong to oblong, apex rounded; base auriculate; margin crenate-dentate, ciliate; claw ca 1 mm long; limb 6–9 by 3–5 mm. Stamens: the longest filament, ca 8 mm long; the short ones, ca 3 mm long; anthers ca 1 mm long. Ovary 1–2 mm in diam.; style ca 5 mm long, glabrous. Mericarps pale yellow or white hairy; all three wings similar, linear, spine-like, apex acute, or middle wing often apically lobed, 1–1.5 cm long.

description: Scandent shrub; branchlets sparsely to densely pubescent, with Yellowish hairs when young, later glabrescent. Leaves elliptic (to broadly elliptic) to ovate 4–12 by 1–5–7 cm, apex obtuse to finely acute, base cuneate to rounded or truncate, usually 3-nerved with the side nerves supra-basal, main lateral nerves ca 2 pairs, both surfaces glabrous, or sparsely pubescent below; petioles 0.8–2 cm, sparsely to densely pubescent. Inflorescence: cymose to thyrsoid, 1–4(–12) by 0.5–1.5(–2.5) cm, pubescent. Male flowers yellow on pubescent pedicels, 1–2 mm; sepals 7–11, outer ones minute and bracteoliform, sub-triangular, scarcely 1 mm long, puberulous outside; inner 4–5, ovate-rotund, 2.5 by 1–1.75 mm, glabrous; petals 5, obovate, ca 1 mm long; stamens 9–10(–14), connate at the base only, free above, 1–1.75 mm long. Female flowers: sepals and petais as in male; carpels 2, scarcely 1 mm long; stigma plate-like. Drupes yellow to red on pedicels, 1–4 cm, subglobose, (5–)6–8 mm diam.; endocarp rugulose, sometimes perforate.

description: Woody climber, up to 15 m or more high, branchlets densely puberulous at first, later glabrescent. Leaves ovate to elliptic-ovate, 10–26 by 5–16 cm, base cuneate to rounded, 5-nerved, apex acute with long mucronate acumen; lateral nerves, 2–3 pairs, sparsely to moderately puberulous and very finely reticulate on both surfaces, papyraceous; petiole 2–5 cm, puberulous. Inflorescence cymose, few-flowered, 0.75–1.5 cm long, puberulous. Male flowers cream on pedicels, 1–2 mm; sepals 6 or 9, tomentose; outer 3 or 6 minute, up to 0.75 mm long; inner 3 elliptic, 2 by 1.25 mm; petals 6, tomentose, broadly elliptic, 1 mm long; stamens 6, sublinear. glabrous, 1.5 mm; rudimentary carpels 3. Female flowers: sepals and petals larger than in male; carpels 3, obliquely subellipsoidal, 2 mm long; style elongate, grooved; staminodes linear, 1 mm. Drupes unknown.

description: WoodY climber, up to about 10 m; branchlets, petioles and Inflorescences covered with a very short, velvety, ± yellow-brown indumentum. Leaves elliptic, oblong-elliptic, broadly elliptic or elliptic-obovate, 9–25 by 3–10 cm, base acute to rounded, 3-nerved, apex usually acutely acuminate, mucronulate, lateral nerves 4 pairs, prominent on flower surface, both surfaces glabrous apart from puberulous midrib; papyraceous; petiole 1.5–4 cm. Male inflorescences pseudo-paniculate, often about 3 arising together, 5–16 cm long, with very slender branches. Male flowers greenish-yellow, subsessile; sepals 9, ± ovate, tomentose; outer 3 minute, 0.5 mm long; middle 3, 0.75 mm long; inner 3, 1.5 mm long and broad; petals 6, obovate, 0.75 mm long, glabrous; stamens 6, claviform, 0.75 mm. Female inflorescences similar to male but shorter, 1–4 cm long, branches thickening when in fruit. Female flowers: sepals and petals, ± as in male; carpels 3, obliquely ellipsoidal, 1 mm long; stigma auriculate; staminodes linear. Drupes yellow, obliquely obovate in outline, 14–20 by 12–16 mm, puberulous to glabrescent.

description: Woody climber; young branchlets, petioles and inflorescences yellowish togolden-brown (or rusty) tomentose, branchlets later glabrescent. Leaves ovate-elliptic, elliptic or obovate-elliptic, 7–17 by 3–8 cm, base cuneate to rounded, 3-nerved, apex usually broad and abruptly cuspidate, or obtusely apiculate (occassionally long acuminate); lateral nerves 4–6 pairs; both surfaces at first yellowish to golden-brown pubescent or tomentose, especially on flower surface along the nerves, later glabrescent, stiffly papyraceous. Inflorescences up to 2.5 cm, composed of about 2–6, densely-flowered-cymes, 4–5 mm across with peduncles (3–)10–20 mm. Male flowers green to white, subsessile; sepals 9, ovate, tomentose; outer 3, 1 by 0.75 mm; middle 3, 1.25 by 1 mm; inner 3, 2.5–3.25 by 1.75–2.5 mm, thick; petals 6, obovate, unguiculate, 1.5 mm long, glabrous; stamens 6, claviform, 1 mm, filaments usually sparsely pilose adaxially. Female flowers: sepals and petals, ± as in male; petals clasping linear staminodes; carpels 3, ± obliquely ellipsoidal, 1.5 by 1.25 mm; stigma auriculate. Drupes obliquely obovate in outline, 20–25 by 16–20 mm, pubescent to glabrescent.

description: Tree 5–10 m high, sometimes a shrub; branches glabrous. Leaflets 3 (rarely4), subsessile, obovate, oblong or linear, (2–)5–7(–12) by 1–3 cm, subcoriaceous or papery, glabrous on both sides; base cuneate or obtuse; apex emarginate or rounded, with short mucro; nerves very thin, finely reticulate. Petiole 1.5–6.5 cm, slender. Flowers in terminal or lateral corymb or raceme; a short terminal panicle, or the flowers solitary in the axils of the upper leaves. Pedicels 1.5–5.5 cm. Bracts linear, smal 1. Sepals ovate, 7–10 by 2–3 mm, apex acuminate, glabrous on both sides, woolly at the margin. Stamens 9–12; filaments 10–15 mm, robust; anthers oblong, 1.5–2 mm; apex mucronate. Gynophore 1.5–2 cm, robust, glabrous. Ovary cylindrical, 1.5–2 by 1 mm, glabrous. Fruit ellipsoidal or rounded, 2–2.5 by 1.3–1.5 cm; stipe 4.5–7.5 cm, slender. Seed reniform.

description: Herb up to 1.5 m high; glabrous or minutely pubescent, reddish or glauccscent. Leaves ovate, acuminate to ± cordate or triangular, 5–15 by 2–9 cm, ± puberulous. Involucral bracts united at base, 10–15 mm long; during anthesis puberulous. Flowers subsessile, 4–5 together. Perianth-tube finely puberulous outside, 3–6 cm; limb ca 3 cm diam., with short, obtuse or emarginate lobes, variously coloured, white, pink, yellow. Stamens 5(–6), exserted ca 1 cm; anthers ± glabrous; filaments reddish, flower half adnate to the tube. Ovary ovoid, 1.5 mm long; ovule solitary, surrounded by a few scales; style equalling the stamens in length, reddish; stigma capitate with few short lobes. Anthocarp ovoid, 7–9 mm, 5-ribbed, black. Nut subglobose, ca 7 mm. Seed 1.

description: Leaves elliptic to broadly elliptic, 5–12 by 2.5–8 cm, base obtuse to rounded, apex obtuse, nerves and reticulation generally prominent on both surfaces, lower surface puberulous, sometimes sparsely, upper surface glabrous; usually drying olivaceous on both sides; petiole 1–4 cm. Inflorescences 4–10 cm, yellowish pubescent; the flowers in spaced, ± sessile clusters. Male flowers sessile or subsessile; main sepals 6, yellow broadly elliptic, ca 2.5 mm long, densely pubescent outside, pubescent inside; the outer 3 narrower; petals narrowly pointed at apex, 2–2.25 mm long; stamens 1.5 mm long. Female flowers: sepals as in male; petals 1.5 mm long; staminodes 0; carpels densely hairy, 0.75 mm long; style elongate recurved. Drupes yellowish tomentose, 1.5 cm long.

description: Leaves usually oblong-elliptic, 7–10 by 2.5–3.5(–4.5) cm, base cuneate to rounded, apex mostly btoadly pointed, nerves and reticulation rather inconspicuous, especially above, both surfaces glabrous when adult, drying blackish-brown; petiole 1–2 cm. Inflorescences 7–25 cm, yellowish pubescent, the flowers in spaced clusters which are sessile, or sometimes on branches, up to 3 mm long. Male flowers sessile, scented; sepals white or yellow, sparsely to moderately pubescent outside, glabrous within; the 3 innermost sepals broadly elliptic, 2.5 mm long; the next outer 3 much smaller; petals rounded at apex, 1.5–1.75 mm long; stamens 1.25 mm long. Female flowers: sepals and petals similar to male; staminodes 6; carpels glabrous, 1.5 mm long including recurved style. Drupes glabrous, 1 cm long.
